registered_before: any outcome of this rule was computed; the October 21 behavior audit's association (entries while the day was already green: 642 trades, -$8,942) was already known and motivated the rule, and the October 24 exit study had already read the same extract
question: Had the owner stopped opening new trades for the rest of the day once the day's realized P&L was above $X, would the October 2025-26 long option trades have kept more money, and is the saving more than trading less by the same premium would give?

population.trades: every trade in the exit-counterfactual-20261024-v1 extract (closed or expired long option trades opened 2025-07-10 to 2026-10-19), including those held longer than 10 days; no option bars are needed
population.extract: the same file the exit study read, produced by `python -m scripts.exit_counterfactual_study extract`; registered bytes sha256 023e0e11302cdc685f789dfd452d103feeb36d87385232c819fc8eedb1878eda. A run on any other file reports extract_is_registered false and must say so
excluded_and_counted: a fill side other than buy_to_open or sell_to_close
fills that do not allocate first-in-first-out

position_accounting: each trade's P&L and entry premium come from its actual fills replayed first in first out (exit study Position); what is left open at the end expired worthless
day_pnl: the day's realized P&L at an instant is the sum, over trades kept by the counterfactual whose closed_at falls on that New York calendar day strictly before the instant, of their whole-trade P&L; both accounts together; partial exits count only when the trade closes, as realized_pnl_today_before does

rules.stop_above_0: trigger at the first trade close that lifts the day's realized P&L above $0; every trade whose first entry is later that day (strictly after the trigger) is not taken
rules.order: days are processed in date order so a skipped multi-day trade never counts toward a later day's P&L; adds to a position opened before the trigger are kept

outcomes.primary: total dollar difference, counterfactual minus actual (minus the skipped trades' P&L), over every trade in the population
secondary: aggregate return on premium, counterfactual minus actual, in percentage points (total P&L / total entry premium)
size-neutral: skipped trades' mean return on premium minus the kept trades' mean, in points (below 0 favors the rule)
benchmark, trading less by the same premium: every trade scaled by (1 - skipped premium / total premium); selection value = rule difference minus that flat cut's difference
outcomes.uncertainty: 2,000 bootstrap resamples by New York trading day of first entry (seed 20261024); Bonferroni across the 3 thresholds: 98.33% two-sided intervals for primary decisions

periods.independence: neither period is untouched: the audit that motivated the rule read both, and the thresholds were chosen knowing its result. Every result is exploratory; a positive check half is consistency, not confirmation

decisions.supported_saving: primary 98.33% interval above 0, and in each period: at least one trade skipped, dollar difference above 0, aggregate return-on-premium difference above 0, and skipped trades' mean return on premium below the kept trades'
decisions.selection_informative: supported_saving and the selection value's 98.33% interval above 0

outcomes.supported_saving and selection_informati: eligible for prospective testing as a daily stop
outcomes.supported_saving only: investigate further: the saving is trading less, not stopping once green
outcomes.primary interval below 0: reject: stopping once green would have cost money

limits: stock trades and positions open at extract time are not in the extract, so the day's P&L omits them
skipping later entries assumes the owner would not have traded differently in other ways (no substitution, no different size on earlier trades)
dollars are dominated by position size; the size-neutral difference is the check
the audit measured the association; this asks what the rule would have done, on the same trades, so it cannot confirm the audit independently
prospective: not registered here; a forward test needs its own protocol id after this run
